lines.text: Many learners say: Went to Kyoto yesterday.
Better: I went to Kyoto yesterday.

native.tip: 日本語は主語を省くのが普通。でも英語では I を省かずに言おう。
native.caption: “Went to Kyoto yesterday.”と言っていませんか？😅 日本語では「京都に行った」で通じますが、英語では主語の I が必要です。“I went to Kyoto yesterday.” が自然な言い方です。Carlosの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“I ate pizza.”。主語の I を忘れずに。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.hook: Do you drop the I in “Went to Kyoto”?
en.tip: Japanese often drops the subject. In English, say I.
en.caption: Do you say “Went to Kyoto yesterday.”? 😅 Japanese can drop the subject, but English needs I. The natural way is “I went to Kyoto yesterday.”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
